title: Engineer answers
description: answers.json in the work folder: the engineer's answers to questions, the highest-trust provenance (common method 'engineer_answer', with the question_id). An answer is bound to the question's stable `key` (see question-registry), never to the positional-looking id alone: when the drawing behind a question changes, the question gets a new key, is asked again, and the old answer becomes 'stale' (kept, never deleted, never re-bound). Written only by `harness answer` (run by the engineer or on the engineer's explicit instruction) and, for the 'stale' transition, by the producers (intake, read-structure, callouts, grid-system). At most one answer per key is 'active'; a later answer to the same key marks the earlier one 'superseded'. Structured `values` are defined for some codes; for all other codes `values` is {}.

answers.description: In the order the answers were given.

key.description: Stable key of the answered question (question-registry).

question_id.description: The id the question had when it was answered.

file.description: Input-relative path the question is about; null for a project-level question.

values.description: Structured values, only for the codes listed in allOf below; {} for every other code.

stale_reason.description: Only when status is 'stale': why (input file changed or removed, question no longer raised).

values.description: The unit the engineer confirms on purpose although the drawing's dimensions contradict it: {"unit": "m"}; harness answer accepts only the unit already answered for the file.

Tekla axis of each direction of the system, as the question names them: {"dir1": "X", "dir2": "Y"}. harness answer requires exactly the question's directions with distinct axes; {} is allowed only for answers recorded before values existed (they assign nothing).
Tekla axis of each grid family: {"<family_id>": "X"}.
Meaning of each member mark prefix: {"<prefix>": "<meaning>"}.

Optional: the grid systems the project uses, {"systems": ["S001", "S002"]} (ids of the grid-systems.json the question was raised from). Without it every system listed in the question counts as used; systems outside it raise no blocking question. Optional `separate`: two or more listed (and, with `systems`, selected) systems that are different buildings; it closes the grid_system_conflict questions between them.
